facts.business: Vikas WSP Limited manufactures and sells guar-based products.

auditor.name: M/s Deviyal K. & Co., Chartered Accountant
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Statutory Auditors issued audit reports containing qualified remarks; Company has not attached Statement on Impact of Audit Qualifications.

key_risks: Company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since February 2022
No business operations at the time of CIRP initiation
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations including delayed financial results, annual report, shareholding pattern, and SDD software
Promoters' delayed disclosures and pending ROC filings
Unspent CSR amount not transferred to separate account
Corporate guarantee of Rs. 5000 lacs provided to related parties under Section 185
Recoverable amount doubtful as company is under liquidation
facts.related_party_note: The company has provided corporate guarantee to the tune of Rs. 5000 lacs to the related parties as defined under section 185 of the Act. All Related Party Transactions entered during the year were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. Outstanding balances at year-end are unsecured and settlement occurs in cash. No impairment of receivables relating to amounts owed by related parties for year ended 31 March 2024 (2022-23: Nil crore).
